records.notes: Published in Blizzard's WoW Forever Beta development notes; the notes describe the beta client. Whether the release client matches, and the in-game effective date and build, are not verified.

set.description: Reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next 3 spells or abilities by 10% and increases their damage or healing by 10%. It does not affect periodic effects; channeled spells do not count as periodic.

previous.description: Reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next 3 spells or abilities by 10% and increases their damage or healing by 10%.

details: Restores 35% of your Health and Mana in total (community catalogue).
Cannot be used while you are immune to Physical damage.
